gjort: Budget round: the LISTICLE campaign is cut 2 850 → 2 000 kr/day. 3-day profit fell to 11.1 % at ROAS 1.99, under the 16 % floor. Its cadence lock had just expired, so the cut went through. Read back and logged

The main campaign holds at 9 600 kr for one more night — 3-day profit 12.9 % is under the floor too, but only 2 of the required 3 days have passed since Monday's raise. Unless it recovers today it gets cut 9 600 → 6 720 kr tomorrow night
Paused one ad: CaraShellRoof_BOF_107_1 — 2 153 kr and 3 purchases at CPA 718 kr against break-even 693 kr, losing on both the 14-day and the 7-day window
108 purchases over 7 days on 54 740 kr at ROAS 2.73. Profit contribution 36 911 kr, flat against last night despite 8 800 kr more spend — which is the whole story tonight
varningar: The main campaign has hit a delivery ceiling and the last two nights proved it. Day by day: 3 100-5 100 kr/day bought 10-13 purchases at ROAS 2.5-5.8, then spend jumped to 11 757 and 9 588 kr and bought 13 and 14 purchases at ROAS 1.70 and 1.92. Roughly two and a half times the money for about 20 % more customers. The budget was raised 8 000 → 9 600 on Monday, but Meta had never actually been delivering the old 8 000 — it was spending around 5 000. The profitable ROAS we scaled on was measured at a spend level the campaign was not really running at

So the cuts coming are the rules working, not the product dying. Purchases are holding up fine; it is the price per purchase that broke. Expect the round to walk both campaigns back down over the next few nights until profit returns to the 16-25 % band
Norway and Denmark still run unwatched on 4 000 kr/day each — reported last night, nothing changed since. Only Sweden is managed by this round
